title: Rotate leaked Appwrite API key + remove in-code default
description:
application.yml line 94 ships a real Appwrite server API key as a fallback default (${APPWRITE_API_KEY:<literal>}). The key is in git history, so deleting the literal does NOT unleak it.

ACTIONS:
1. Rotate/regenerate the Appwrite server API key in the Appwrite console (the committed key is compromised the moment it entered git; it is sent as X-Appwrite-Key on every token validation).
2. Remove the in-code default so the placeholder is ${APPWRITE_API_KEY} with NO fallback - app must fail at startup if unset (production should refuse to boot rather than run with a phantom key).
3. Store the new key only in .env / deployment secrets (already gitignored; verified .env, .env.dev, docker/development/.env are in .gitignore and not tracked).
4. OPTIONAL/heavier: history scrub (git filter-repo/BFG). Not required - rotation makes the leaked key worthless.

Context: security-module rewrite for Spring Boot 4. Dev profile never calls Appwrite, so dev does not need the key. endpoint + project_id keeping defaults is acceptable; a secret key must not.
close_reason: Code-side fix landed in commit 8a60702. application.yml + application.yml (test) now have ${APPWRITE_API_KEY} with NO fallback — app will fail at startup if the env var is unset. ./gradlew compileJava compileTestJava → BUILD SUCCESSFUL. The literal key still lives in the gitignored .env, .env.dev, .env.migrate files; user must rotate the key in the Appwrite console and update those 3 files with the new value before next deploy. History scrub explicitly noted as optional by the issue and not required once the key is rotated.

title: ADR-0017 golongan (EXEMPLAR): pindah GolonganQueries/Repository/Mapper ke jooq/jpa/mapper
description: EXEMPLAR/template untuk ADR-0017 (parent kepegawaian-hgg). Kerjakan domain golongan end-to-end sebagai pola yang ditiru 12 domain lain. Branch rewrite/master-cqrs. Scope KETAT: hanya 4 file golongan + importer GolonganRepository.

   - ./gradlew compileJava (JANGAN jalankan JOOQ codegen, ADR-0012/0015).
   - gitnexus_detect_changes() -> pastikan hanya symbol golongan + importer yang berubah.

6. JANGAN commit/push tanpa konfirmasi manager. Lapor hasil + daftar file berubah.

title: F6.S2: Migrasi klien Appwrite WebClient -> RestClient (drop webflux)
design:
Patuhi WORKING AGREEMENT epic 5x7 (gitnexus dulu, context7 dulu, DRY/KISS, SCOPE KETAT).

TUJUAN: Hilangkan WebFlux. Ganti WebClient (reactive) dengan Spring RestClient (sinkron) untuk panggilan Appwrite. Sekaligus perbaiki semantik error yang sekarang ditelan jadi null.

context7 WAJIB: Spring Framework 7 `RestClient` — builder/baseUrl, `.get().uri(...).header(...).retrieve().body(Class)`, dan penanganan status `.onStatus(HttpStatusCode::is4xxClientError, ...)` / 5xx. Pastikan paket & API.

gitnexus WAJIB: gitnexus_context untuk JwtTokenService + WebClientConfig + AuthController; gitnexus_impact({direction:"upstream"}) pada JwtTokenService SEBELUM edit — WARN bila HIGH/CRITICAL (filter auth bergantung padanya).

FILE (SCOPE KETAT):
- src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/config/WebClientConfig.java -> jadikan RestClientConfig: bean RestClient (RestClient.builder().baseUrl(${appwrite.endpoint}).build()). Rename file/kelas via gitnexus_rename, BUKAN find-replace.
- src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/config/security/JwtTokenService.java -> pakai RestClient. getUserFromToken(): GET {endpoint}/account/jwt + header X-Appwrite-Project / X-Appwrite-Key / X-Appwrite-JWT, body -> AppwriteUser.
- src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/controllers/auth/AuthController.java -> /auth/session pakai RestClient (bukan WebClient). HAPUS endpoint /auth/csrf-token (CSRF dibuang di rewrite security; RedisHelper.generateToken tak dipakai lagi di sini).

SEMANTIK ERROR (perbaikan inti, jangan dilewat):
- Lama: try/catch menelan SEMUA error jadi null -> semua tampak 401. SALAH.
- Baru: pakai .onStatus. Token ditolak Appwrite (401/403) -> lempar yang dipetakan ke 401 Unauthorized. Appwrite tak terjangkau / 5xx / timeout -> petakan ke 503 Service Unavailable. Jangan kembalikan null buta.

DRY/KISS: satu bean RestClient dipakai bersama. Jangan bikin wrapper/abstraksi tambahan. Jangan retry/circuit-breaker (di luar scope — buat issue baru bila perlu).

ANTI-SLOP: jangan menambah DTO baru selain yang sudah ada (AppwriteUser/Prefs). Jangan ubah signature publik JwtTokenService kecuali perlu untuk membedakan 401 vs 503.

Alur tutup: gitnexus_detect_changes() -> hanya 3 file di atas + rename -> ./gradlew compileJava -> bd close.
acceptance_criteria: Tidak ada lagi import org.springframework.web.reactive.* di kode app; JWT valid -> AppwriteUser ter-resolve; token salah -> 401; Appwrite mati -> 503 (bukan 401); kompilasi hijau tanpa webflux.

title: F6.S1: Migrasi OpenApiConfig ke springdoc-openapi 3.x (Boot 4)
design:
Patuhi WORKING AGREEMENT epic 5x7 (gitnexus dulu, context7 dulu, DRY/KISS, SCOPE KETAT). Issue ini SUDAH spesifik — jangan improvisasi di luar yang tertulis.

TUJUAN: OpenApiConfig jalan di Spring Boot 4 + springdoc 3.x. Perubahan MEKANIS, bukan redesign.

context7 WAJIB: springdoc-openapi 3.0.x — pastikan paket `org.springdoc.core.models.GroupedOpenApi` + `.group()/.pathsToMatch()/.build()` MASIH SAMA (di 3.x tidak berubah; verifikasi, jangan asal ganti import). Cek juga io.swagger.v3 OpenAPI/Components/SecurityScheme.

FILE (SCOPE KETAT — hanya ini):
- src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/config/OpenApiConfig.java

PERUBAHAN (HANYA ini, jangan tambah/kurang grup):
1. HAPUS anotasi @EnableWebMvc (di Boot, ini mematikan WebMvcAutoConfiguration → swagger-ui rusak). Itu sisa copy-paste. Hapus anotasi + importnya saja.
2. Sisanya BIARKAN VERBATIM: bean openAPI() (scheme global HTTP/bearer/JWT "BearerAuthentication" + .security(...)) dan ke-10 bean GroupedOpenApi (masterApi /master/**, profileApi /profil/**, pegawaiApi /pegawai/**, kepegawaianApi /kepegawaian/**, penggajianApi /penggajian/**, userApi /auth/**, systemApi /system/**, laporanKepegawaianApi /laporan/kepegawaian/**, cutiApi /cuti/**). JANGAN rename, JANGAN gabung, JANGAN ubah pathsToMatch.

JANGAN sentuh WebSecurity/SecurityConfig di sini (permitAll path swagger diurus issue S3).

ANTI-SLOP: bila tergoda "merapikan" grup atau scheme — JANGAN. Diff yang benar = hapus @EnableWebMvc + import, mungkin sesuaikan 1 import springdoc bila context7 menunjukkan beda paket. Tidak lebih.

Alur tutup: gitnexus_detect_changes() → hanya OpenApiConfig berubah → ./gradlew compileJava → bd close.
acceptance_criteria: App start tanpa error; GET /v3/api-docs/** & /swagger-ui/** 200; ke-10 GroupedOpenApi grup tetap muncul; tombol Authorize (Bearer JWT) tampil.

title: E0 (EXEMPLAR): Golongan — pola kanonik CQRS satu entity master flat
design:
Implementasi Golongan END-TO-END sebagai POLA RUJUKAN. Semua entity master lain meniru struktur ini — buat sebersih mungkin. Golongan = entity flat paling sederhana (tanpa relasi).

WAJIB gitnexus dulu: gitnexus_context({name:"GolonganServiceImpl"}) & gitnexus_query untuk paham perilaku CRUD lama yang ditiru. WAJIB context7 untuk JOOQ DSL (selectFrom, pagination, sort), Spring Data JPA save, jakarta validation.

=== STRUKTUR FILE (layer-first, ADR-0006) — SCOPE KETAT, hanya file Golongan ===
ENTITY (write):
- entities/master/Golongan.java — extends MasterBaseEntity (F5); field domain: kode, nama. @SQLDelete/@SQLRestriction.

DTO:
- dto/master/golongan/GolonganRequest.java — write DTO (POST/PUT body), @Valid. Field: kode, nama.
- dto/master/golongan/GolonganQuery.java — read row DTO (index/list/{id} projection). HANYA field yang dipakai klien (jangan over-fetch).
- dto/master/golongan/GolonganIndexQuery.java — filter index (free-text → ilike; FK/enum/int → equal). Extends/compose PageQuery (F4).

COMMAND (write side):
- services/master/golongan/GolonganCommandService.java — @Service concrete (ADR-0007, no interface). create→insert (201 {id}); update→load-or-404 (ADR-0014) lalu apply; delete→soft-delete-or-404. Revive-on-create bila unik bentrok row soft-deleted (ADR-0005). FK (jika ada) via getReferenceById→EntityNotFoundException→409 (ADR-0008). Tidak ada di Golongan, tapi catat polanya.
- services/master/golongan/GolonganMapper.java — PURE function: Request→Entity & sebaliknya untuk write. Tanpa side-effect, tanpa akses repo.

QUERY (read side, JOOQ):
- services/master/golongan/GolonganQueryService.java — @Service concrete; orchestrate, panggil GolonganQueries.
- services/master/golongan/GolonganQueries.java — DSL JOOQ: page query (offset/limit), sort whitelist (cegah SQL injection lewat nama kolom), proyeksi ke GolonganQuery. GET/{id} hilang → throw NotFoundException→404 (ADR-0014).

REPO:
- repositories/master/GolonganRepository.java — Spring Data JPA (write side saja).

CONTROLLER:
- controllers/master/GolonganController.java — @RequestMapping("/master/golongan"). 
  GET index (paged via @ParameterObject GolonganIndexQuery), GET list, GET /{id}, POST, PUT /{id}, DELETE /{id}.
  Mutasi (POST/PUT/DELETE) WAJIB @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')"). Bungkus respons via helper F4 (ApiResponse). Controller TIPIS — delegasi ke service, tanpa logika.

=== ATURAN ===
- DRY/KISS: command pakai JPA, query pakai JOOQ. TANPA bus, TANPA interface+Impl. Mapper pure.
- DROP: batch endpoint, @Version, Envers.
- SCOPE KETAT: hanya file Golongan + daftar di atas. Jangan sentuh entity lain.
- gitnexus_detect_changes() sebelum commit — pastikan hanya symbol Golongan berubah.

Rujukan ADR: 0005, 0006, 0007, 0008, 0010, 0013, 0014. Memory: rewrite-package-layout, rewrite-master-base-class, rewrite-fk-getreference, rewrite-revive-on-create-unique-softdelete, rewrite-jooq-page-query, rewrite-write-success-codes, rewrite-index-filter-contract.
Selesai: 6 endpoint Golongan jalan end-to-end; `./gradlew test` hijau; ini jadi rujukan semua E* berikut.

title: F5: Base class master (@MappedSuperclass) + JPA auditing
design:
Buat base entity master & infrastruktur JPA auditing. (Konfigurasi security DIPISAH ke issue S1–S3; F5 fokus persistence saja.)

WAJIB context7 dulu: Spring Data JPA @MappedSuperclass + AuditingEntityListener, @EnableJpaAuditing, AuditorAware, Hibernate @SQLDelete/@SQLRestriction (Boot 4 / Hibernate 7). Versi internalmu mungkin basi.

WAJIB gitnexus dulu: pahami base entity & pola soft-delete lama via gitnexus_context (mis. AbstractEntity / kolom audit lama).

Lingkup file (SCOPE KETAT):
- MasterBaseEntity (@MappedSuperclass): id (IDENTITY Long), created_by/at + updated_by/at (JPA auditing), is_deleted. DROP @Version, @Audited/Envers, changed_status (ADR-0003, 0010). Field audit TIDAK masuk DTO response apa pun.
- @SQLDelete + @SQLRestriction("is_deleted = FALSE") pola soft-delete (diwarisi entity master).
- AuditorAware bean untuk created_by/updated_by. @EnableJpaAuditing aktif.

DRY/KISS: satu base class diwarisi semua entity master. Jangan duplikasi kolom audit per-entity.

Rujukan: docs/adr/0003, 0010; memory rewrite-master-base-class. Selesai: kompilasi; @EnableJpaAuditing aktif; soft-delete bekerja.

title: F4: Foundation slice — ApiResponse, PageResult, RestControllerAdvice, typed exceptions
design:
Buat artefak kontrak bersama yang dipakai SEMUA endpoint master. Dibangun sebelum endpoint apa pun.

WAJIB context7 dulu: Spring Framework 7 @RestControllerAdvice, MethodArgumentNotValidException, Jackson 3 serialisasi Instant ISO-8601 default, ResponseEntity di Spring 7. Cek apakah ProblemDetail auto-aktif (kita TOLAK ProblemDetail, ADR-0013).

Lingkup file (SCOPE KETAT — buat baru di package commons/dto + exception):
- ApiResponse<T>(int status, String statusText, T data, Instant timestamp) — record, envelope sukses & error (ADR-0013).
- PageResult<T> + PageQuery records (paging response & request) — bentuk dari memory rewrite-jooq-page-query.
- Helper builder respons sukses: POST→201 {id}, PUT→200 {id}, DELETE→200 null, GET-by-id→200 data.
- GlobalExceptionAdvice (@RestControllerAdvice, SATU-satunya): 
  * MethodArgumentNotValidException → 400, data = list "field : message" (paritas ErrorResult lama).
  * EntityNotFoundException (dari getReferenceById, ADR-0008) → 409.
  * NotFoundException typed (baru) → 404 (ADR-0014, untuk GET/{id}/update/delete row hilang).
  Semua dirender sebagai ApiResponse<Object>, BUKAN ProblemDetail (ADR-0013).
- NotFoundException (typed) untuk 404.

DRY/KISS: satu advice, satu envelope sukses+error. Jangan bikin per-controller error handling.

Rujukan: docs/adr/0008, 0013, 0014; memory rewrite-error-envelope-symmetric-apiresponse, rewrite-get-by-id-missing-404, rewrite-jooq-page-query.
Selesai: kelas-kelas kompilasi; unit test kecil advice memetakan 3 exception → status benar.

title: F3: Task Gradle codegen JOOQ via GenerationTool (manual, sumber di-commit)
design:
Buat satu custom Gradle task imperatif yang menjalankan codegen JOOQ via org.jooq.codegen.GenerationTool.generate(config) — BUKAN plugin (ADR-0012).

WAJIB context7 dulu: API GenerationTool & org.jooq.meta.jaxb.* (Configuration, Jdbc, Generator, Database, Target), Testcontainers MariaDBContainer, Flyway programmatic migrate. Versi internalmu mungkin basi.

Lingkup file (SCOPE KETAT):
- build.gradle.kts (tambah task `jooqCodegen` saja; jangan ubah dep app yang sudah di F1)
- buildSrc/ ATAU blok task inline — pilih yang paling KISS.

Rantai task (ADR-0012, di SATU task):
1. start Testcontainers MariaDB
2. Flyway migrate ke kontainer itu
3. ambil JDBC URL live kontainer sebagai variabel LOKAL → serahkan ke org.jooq.meta.jaxb.Jdbc
4. GenerationTool.generate(config) → output ke src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/jooq/
5. stop kontainer

KRITIS (ADR-0015):
- Task ini TIDAK disambungkan ke compileJava. Dijalankan MANUAL (`./gradlew jooqCodegen`) hanya saat skema berubah.
- Output sumber JOOQ DI-COMMIT ke git (src/main/java/.../jooq/). compileJava & CI TIDAK PERNAH start kontainer.
- Target package generated: id.perumdamts.kepegawaian.jooq.

DRY/KISS: nol bridging URL — URL hanya variabel lokal. Satu titik kendali up→migrate→generate→down.

Rujukan: docs/adr/0012, 0015. Selesai: `./gradlew jooqCodegen` menghasilkan sumber JOOQ ter-commit untuk tabel master dari F2.

design:
Tulis migration Flyway V1 untuk seluruh tabel master + seed dev. Flyway = sumber kebenaran skema; Hibernate ddl-auto=validate (ADR-0002).

WAJIB gitnexus dulu: pahami skema lama dari entity di src/.../entities/master/ (17 entity). WAJIB context7 untuk sintaks Flyway (penamaan versi, flyway-mysql untuk MariaDB).

Lingkup file (SCOPE KETAT):
- src/main/resources/db/migration/V1_0_0__create_master.sql
- src/main/resources/db/migration/V1_0_1__seed_master.sql (seed dev, gantikan SetupMaster yang dibuang)
- application.yml: set spring.flyway.* + jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=validate. JANGAN ubah config lain.

Tabel: golongan, level, jenjang_pendidikan, jenis_keahlian, jenis_pelatihan, jenis_kitas, alasan_berhenti, rumah_dinas, hari_libur, organisasi(self-ref parent_id), jabatan(self-ref + level_id + golongan_idx), grade(self-ref + level_id), profesi(+ level_id denorm dari jabatan per ADR-0009), apd(profesi_id FK), alat_kerja(profesi_id FK), jenis_sp, sanksi(jenis_sp_id FK).

Rujukan: docs/adr/0002, 0009, 0010, 0011. Selesai: `./gradlew flywayMigrate` (atau bootRun dev) sukses migrate ke MariaDB lokal.

title: F1: build.gradle.kts — Gradle Kotlin DSL untuk Spring Boot 4.0.3 + JOOQ
design:
Buat/migrasi build script ke Gradle Kotlin DSL (build.gradle.kts) untuk Spring Boot 4.0.3 (Spring Framework 7, Spring Security 7), Java 21.

WAJIB context7 dulu: cek koordinat & API Spring Boot 4.0.3 BOM, Spring Dependency Management, plugin Gradle Kotlin DSL, JOOQ 3.19+, Flyway, Testcontainers MariaDB, springdoc-openapi 3.0.x. Versi internalmu mungkin basi.

Lingkup file (SCOPE KETAT — hanya ini):
- build.gradle.kts (baru, gantikan build.gradle bila ada)
- settings.gradle.kts
- gradle/libs.versions.toml bila pakai version catalog

Isi:
- Dependency aplikasi: spring-boot-starter-web, -data-jpa, -validation, -security, -actuator, -data-redis, kafka, jooq, flyway-core + flyway-mysql, mariadb-java-client, lombok.
- springdoc: `org.springdoc:springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui` versi 3.0.x (rilis untuk Boot 4). Lama 2.8.13 (webmvc) TIDAK jalan di Boot 4 — cek versi stabil terbaru via context7.
- DROP `spring-boot-starter-webflux` (build lama membawanya hanya untuk WebClient; sisi sync dipindah ke RestClient di issue Appwrite-client). Jangan bawa webflux ke runtime.
- Konfigurasi `jooqCodegen` TERISOLASI (ADR-0012): dependency codegen (org.jooq:jooq-codegen + driver MariaDB + Flyway + Testcontainers) di configuration `jooqCodegen` sendiri, TIDAK bocor ke runtime classpath app.
- JANGAN pakai plugin org.jooq.jooq-codegen-gradle (ADR-0012). Task codegen dibuat di F3.
- compileJava TIDAK bergantung pada task codegen (ADR-0015).

DRY/KISS: jangan tambah plugin/dep yang tak dipakai. Jangan utak-atik konfigurasi lain di luar build.

Rujukan: docs/adr/0012, docs/adr/0015. Selesai: `./gradlew help` jalan tanpa error resolusi; springdoc 3.0.x & TANPA webflux di classpath.

title: Rewrite modul MASTER ke Spring Boot 4 + CQRS (JPA write / JOOQ read)
design:
Rewrite modul `master` dari nol ke arsitektur baru. Bahasa TETAP Java; hanya build script jadi build.gradle.kts. Lightweight CQRS: JPA sisi tulis, JOOQ sisi baca, satu MariaDB. Tujuan inti: DTO response spesifik per-endpoint (hanya muat relasi yang dipakai endpoint itu) — bukan satu DTO gemuk over-fetch seperti kode lama.

Cakupan entity master (17 entity + 5 enum read-only):

value: CustomResult envelope 'timestamp' field in the SB4 rewrite is an Instant, serialized by Jackson 3 as ISO-8601 by default. Drop the old Jackson-2 '@JsonFormat(pattern="yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")' / LocalDateTimeSerializer entirely — those won't compile under Jackson 3 (tools.jackson.* namespace) anyway. Rationale: timestamp is a machine-readable server-response marker; ISO-8601 Instant is unambiguous and zero-config.

Rewrite sisi baca (JOOQ/CQRS): client-driven projection, satu DTO per kebutuhan endpoint — BUKAN satu response gemuk dipakai semua (keluhan asli: ProfesiResponse lama dipakai di findAll/findByJabatan/findPage/findById sekaligus, selalu load organisasi+jabatan+level+grade+apdList+alatKerjaList walau cuma butuh id+nama). Pola STANDAR berulang untuk semua master: (1) *Option = id+nama saja, query ramping tanpa join (dropdown); (2) *Detail = full termasuk koleksi anak via JOOQ MULTISET (halaman detail). Tingkat menengah (list) DISESUAIKAN per kasus. DTO baca = Java record (immutable), terpisah total dari entity JPA; berhenti pakai Lombok @Data + static from(). Koleksi anak via MULTISET (emulasi JSON_ARRAYAGG MariaDB) 1 round-trip, bukan N+1. PETA KONKRET PROFESI (Q23, locked): /list->ProfesiOption(id,nama); /{id}->ProfesiDetail(semua scalar nama/detail/resiko + organisasi/jabatan/level/grade id+nama + apdList/alatKerjaList via MULTISET); /(page index)->ProfesiListItem(id,nama,resiko + nama FK, TANPA koleksi anak); /jabatan/{id}->ProfesiOption (reuse, dropdown). Jika frontend ternyata pakai /jabatan/{id} utk tabel, naikkan ke ProfesiListItem.

Rewrite soft-delete: master entities sudah punya @SQLDelete+@SQLRestriction, tapi service lama deleteById pakai manual setIsDeleted(true)+save() — itu sebabnya @SQLDelete 'tidak jalan' (hanya menyala saat repository.delete()/EntityManager.remove(), bukan save). Rewrite: service Command panggil repository.delete() saja, buang set manual. Sisi baca JOOQ memintas Hibernate jadi @SQLRestriction TIDAK berlaku di JOOQ — wajib helper terpusat (Conditions.active(table)) untuk filter is_deleted=false di setiap query baca.

rewrite: write-side mapping pakai mapper terpisah (mis. ProfesiMapper), BUKAN static toEntity di request DTO. Alasan: reusable untuk jalur tulis lain (bulk/import) di kemudian hari. Request DTO jadi record pasif (field + validasi Jakarta saja). Cek duplikat pindah ke CommandService pakai derived repository method (existsByNamaAndJabatanIdAndGradeId), bukan Specification/JOOQ. Derive level=jabatan.getLevel() tetap diterapkan saat mapping.

Rewrite master index-filter DTO 'XQuery' is an immutable Java record (NOT mutable @Data like old CommonPageRequest). Spring 6.1+ DataBinder binds query params into record constructors (context7-verified), incl. nested structures + @BindParam. Pagination fields are NOT inheritable since records can't extend a base class, so a single shared record PageQuery(int page, int size, String sortBy, String sortDirection) is COMPOSED into each XQuery, e.g. record ProfesiQuery(Long organisasiId, Long jabatanId, Long levelId, Long gradeId, String nama, PageQuery page). Query params get a 'page.' prefix (?page.size=20&page.sortBy=nama&organisasiId=3). DRY: pagination defined+defaulted once. Replaces old XRequest extends CommonPageRequest + getSpecification(). NOT an ADR (reversible, low surprise). Relates to rewrite-master-dto-naming, rewrite-jooq-page-query.

Rewrite error path (ADR-0013): a single @RestControllerAdvice translates typed exceptions into the SAME ApiResponse<Object>(status,statusText,data,timestamp) envelope as success — NOT Spring 7's framework-default ProblemDetail/RFC 9457. Mapping: MethodArgumentNotValidException->400 with data=list of 'field : message' strings (parity with old ErrorResult.build(Errors)); bad-FK EntityNotFoundException from getReferenceById->409 (ADR-0008); not-found on update/delete->404; data=null for 409/404. Old code had NO @ControllerAdvice anywhere — every controller threaded Errors and returned ErrorResult.build(errors) inline (400-only, no throw). That inline pattern is REJECTED (can't reach 409/404). Centralization is forced; the fork resolved was envelope SHAPE. Chosen A=symmetric ApiResponse (one shape client-wide, KISS, FE never consumes RFC9457 type URIs) over B=ProblemDetail (rejected: two shapes per outcome). Controllers stop returning ErrorResult inline -> they throw, advice shapes body. Advice is a foundation-slice artifact built alongside ApiResponse/PageResult before any master endpoint. Verified SB4/Spring7 ProblemDetail default via context7.

Rewrite master: Jabatan KEEPS the nested sub-resource read endpoint GET /master/jabatan/organisasi/{id} (separate from /list). It returns a FLAT, unpaged, lightweight list (JabatanOption tier: id+nama, NOT the fat detail), filtered WHERE organisasi_id={id} AND is_deleted=false, for the cascading dropdown in the Profesi form (pick Organisasi -> list its Jabatan). This is NOT folded into /list?organisasiId even though the paged index already accepts ?organisasiId filtering -- the dropdown feeder stays its own sub-resource path. So Jabatan has TWO flat-list endpoints: /list (all) and /organisasi/{id} (filtered). Decided in rewrite-plan-grilling; not an ADR (pure code, reversible, no migration).

rewrite master: keunikan domain (Profesi=nama+jabatan_id+grade_id) ditegakkan via UNIQUE polos di DB + revive-on-create. Generated-column DITOLAK (repot saat backup/restore manual MariaDB). MariaDB tak punya partial unique index. CREATE: tuple bentrok dgn bangkai soft-deleted -> hidupkan bangkai (is_deleted=false + timpa field), bukan INSERT baru -> tak pernah ada 2 tuple identik shg UNIQUE polos cukup. Menemukan bangkai: NATIVE QUERY (findAnyByNamaAndJabatanIdAndGradeId, nativeQuery=true) krn @SQLRestriction('is_deleted=FALSE') menyembunyikan bangkai dari semua query Hibernate biasa; native tak tunduk @SQLRestriction. @SQLRestriction TETAP DIPASANG (lindungi semua jalur tulis lain spt resolusi FK findById + self-load update); JOOQ mengabaikannya by design (read pakai Conditions.active(table)) jadi BUKAN alasan menghapusnya. UPDATE: TIDAK pernah revive. Cek native findAnyByNamaAndJabatanIdAndGradeIdAndIdNot(id) -> jika ketemu row APAPUN (aktif/bangkai) lempar DuplicateResourceException 409. AndIdNot supaya update tanpa ubah tuple tak nabrak diri sendiri. Revive=update (updated_by/at terset), id sama. @Filter ditolak; JOOQ di command service ditolak (langgar ADR-0001). Endpoint restore-by-id opsional. Didokumentasikan di ADR-0005 + CONTEXT.md. Migration V1_0_0 harus tambah organisasi_id/jabatan_id/grade_id (belum dideklarasi), version, lalu UNIQUE(nama,jabatan_id,grade_id).

Rewrite master simple lookups (Level, JenisKeahlian, JenisKitas, JenisPelatihan, AlasanBerhenti, RumahDinas, JenjangPendidikan, Golongan + richer HariLibur/JenisSp/Sanksi): PER-ENTITY CONCRETE classes (Q chose A), NOT a generic AbstractMasterCrudService/Controller. Each gets own XCommandService(JPA write)+XQueryService(JOOQ read)+controller+records+mapper, structurally identical to Profesi/Grade just thinner. DRY honored at FINE grain via shared building blocks (base @MappedSuperclass entity per rewrite-master-base-class, ApiResponse/PageResult, Conditions.active(table), filter->condition helpers) NOT a god-generic control-flow skeleton. Rationale: genericizable surface (command orchestration) is small; non-genericizable surface is large — JOOQ read side inherently per-table (generated table classes, hand-built projections), per-entity field divergence (Golongan has NO nama -> golongan+pangkat; JenjangPendidikan +seq/isStatistik; RumahDinas +nilai Double; AlasanBerhenti +notes), and only Level carries UNIQUE(nama) -> revive-on-create per ADR-0005 while the other 7 flat lookups are non-unique. A generic base would force a revive override hook eroding uniformity = exactly what KISS warns against. Consistent w/ ADR-0006 layer-first + ADR-0007 concrete-no-interface. Read tier follows locked standard (rewrite-read-dto-granularity): Option=id+nama, Detail=all scalars no children/MULTISET, index=ListItem. NOT an ADR (reversible: extract base later if real duplication pain appears; follows deductively from KISS+ADR-0006/0007).

rewrite write-side error handling: command service tulis happy-path saja, LEMPAR exception bertipe (ResourceNotFoundException->404 untuk FK/id tak ada; DuplicateResourceException->409). Satu @RestControllerAdvice memetakan exception->ErrorResult dgn status benar, DAN menyerap MethodArgumentNotValidException shg blok 'if(errors.hasErrors())' per-controller DIHAPUS (DRY). Pensiunkan ESaveStatus/SavedStatus/SavedResult di sisi tulis; respons sukses save = CustomResult.any(dto) 201. Sisi BACA tetap pakai CustomResult.any/list/page utk respons sukses. Catatan jujur: pola lama SavedResult sebenarnya sudah map SUCCESS->201/DUPLICATE->409/FAILED->400, jadi alasan ganti BUKAN status salah, tapi: hapus try/catch(Exception) yg menelan semua jadi FAILED+bocorkan e.getMessage mentah, dan bedakan 404 FK-not-found dari 400.

Q30=B: rewrite mempertahankan struktur paket LAYER-FIRST proyek lama (controllers/master/, services/master/profesi/, repositories/master/, dto/master/profesi/), MENOLAK feature-first vertical slice meski tujuan rewrite menyebut 'vertical slice'. Pemisahan Command/Query tetap per-file (ProfesiCommandService/ProfesiQueryService + ProfesiQueries untuk DSL JOOQ) sesuai ADR-0001 — yang berubah hanya tempat file, bukan teknologinya. Alasan: diff mental lebih kecil, porting kode lama lurus. Trade-off: batas CQRS tidak co-located. Konvensi berlaku semua modul. Lihat docs/adr/0006-layer-first-package-layout.md.

Rewrite master write-success response body = MINIMAL ACK, never a Detail DTO. POST /master/x -> 201 with ApiResponse.data = { id } (the created id). PUT /master/x/{id} -> 200 with data = { id } (echoes path var). DELETE /master/x/{id} -> 200 with data = null. Keeps the Q29 ApiResponse<T>(status,statusText,data,timestamp) envelope on ALL endpoints (rejected bare 201/204 no-envelope for that reason). RATIONALE: old success body was a throwaway String ('Organisasi Saved') stuffed into data, never the entity -- so returning id-only is parity, not a loss. CRITICAL CQRS reason: the command service is JPA-ONLY and must NEVER call the JOOQ query service to assemble a Detail DTO on write -- that would couple the two CQRS sides on every mutation. Client re-GETs the Detail tier (/master/x/{id}) if it needs the full server-resolved record (e.g. level copied from Jabatan per ADR-0009). DUPLICATE/FAILED paths already handled by typed exceptions + @RestControllerAdvice (DuplicateResourceException->409, ResourceNotFoundException->404). NOT an ADR: reversible forward change, no surprising trade-off beyond the CQRS-split reasoning already captured.

Rewrite master module (SB4/JOOQ read side): JOOQ Record->DTO mapping uses Records.mapping(Ctor::new) by-position for all three read DTOs (ProfesiOption, ProfesiListItem, ProfesiDetail). Type-safe at compile (constructor reference, no reflection, no annotations), official JOOQ 3.19+ idiom, composes with nested MULTISET for ProfesiDetail. DISCIPLINE: SELECT field order MUST match record constructor parameter order exactly (by-position mapping).

Rewrite master: Sanksi is a FIRST-CLASS standalone lookup, NOT folded into JenisSp (contrast APD/AlatKerja ADR-0011). Deductive resolution by ADR-0011's OWN principle: APD folded BECAUSE no standalone consumer; Sanksi HAS one — RiwayatSp (kepegawaian) carries a direct @ManyToOne Sanksi sanksi FK (RiwayatSp.java:62), so the SP-issuance form picks a Sanksi directly = needs a standalone Sanksi /list dropdown. Also PatchSanksiJenisSpRequest shows the jenisSp link is independently patchable. Therefore: (1) Sanksi keeps full standalone CRUD + own read endpoints (Option=id+nama[kode?], Detail, index ListItem); write route FLAT /master/sanksi with jenis_sp_id in body (NOT nested like APD) — Sanksi is independently meaningful, jenisSp is an optional/patchable parent link not structural ownership. (2) JenisSp Detail embeds its sanksi children via JOOQ MULTISET per locked read-dto-granularity (Detail = full incl child collections). (3) Sanksi kode UNIQUE(10) -> revive-on-create per ADR-0005 + native tombstone lookup; @Audited DROPPED (ADR-0003, master not audited). All deductive from locked ADRs — NOT a new fork, NOT an ADR.

Rewrite master: ONE request record per entity (e.g. ProfesiRequest), used by BOTH save (POST /master/x) and update (PUT /master/x/{id}). id always from path variable, never in body. Rationale: in old code every master XPutRequest is an EMPTY subclass of XPostRequest (zero added fields, identical validation); Golongan/Grade/Level already share a single PostRequest. Records cannot extend, so keeping Post/Put split would mean copy-pasting all fields+annotations into a second record for no behavioral difference. DRY+KISS -> collapse to one. NOT an ADR (splitting later is a trivial forward change). Validation annotations live on the single record's components. Create-vs-update divergence handled in the Service layer (revive-on-create ADR-0005 affects only Profesi command path, not DTO shape), not via separate DTOs.

JOOQ codegen di rewrite TIDAK pakai plugin official org.jooq.jooq-codegen-gradle. Sebagai gantinya: satu custom Gradle task imperatif yang memanggil org.jooq.codegen.GenerationTool.generate(config) langsung. Alur (ADR-0004): start Testcontainers MariaDB -> Flyway migrate -> ambil JDBC URL live container sebagai variabel lokal -> serahkan ke GenerationTool -> stop container. Alasan: plugin official baca config jdbc.url STATIS (jooq{configuration{jdbc{url}}}), tapi Testcontainers kasih URL random tiap build -> bridging URL dinamis ke plugin butuh lazy-provider/afterEvaluate + koreografi lifecycle di sekitar task yg bukan milik kita. GenerationTool langsung = URL cuma variabel, kontrol imperatif penuh up->migrate->generate->down di satu tempat, 1:1 dgn chain ADR-0004, KISS. Dependency: org.jooq:jooq-codegen di konfigurasi jooqCodegen. Lihat ADR-0012.

JOOQ generated sources di-COMMIT ke git di src/main/java/id/perumdamts/kepegawaian/jooq/, regen MANUAL hanya saat skema berubah (./gradlew jooqCodegen), compileJava TIDAK depend ke codegen task. Alasan: CI = GitHub Actions FREE TIER tidak bisa jalankan container, jadi codegen wajib lokal lalu commit. Ditolak: generate-on-build gitignored (butuh Docker di CI). Disiplin: tiap PR yg ubah Flyway migration WAJIB sertakan hasil regen JOOQ di commit sama. Mengoreksi konsekuensi awal ADR-0012 (compileJava depends). Lihat ADR-0015 + ADR-0012 (sudah di-amend). Mekanisme codegen tetap ADR-0012 (GenerationTool imperatif).

Feedback during /grill-with-docs rewrite design: do NOT re-ask decisions already settled in an approved ADR (e.g. sort-whitelist was already in ADR-0006 via Q30=B — re-asking it = slop). Rewrite master entities DROP @Version/version column entirely (ADR-0010). @Version is Hibernate optimistic locking, NOT audit — verified via context7 hibernate-orm: Envers (@Audited) is independent, audits via separate *_AUD tables (REV/REVTYPE), never reads version. Deductive from: (1) Envers doesn't need @Version, (2) ADR-0003 master is NOT audited, (3) Q36=A master write contract doesn't expose concurrency (last-write-wins parity). So version column would be written by Hibernate but never read/audited/checked → KISS removes it. Master Flyway migration must NOT create a version column. SCOPE GUARD: rewrite master only; old IdsAbstract untouched; penggajian/kepegawaian are audited + may have contention so @Version is a fresh decision there, NOT a blanket project-wide removal.

Rewrite (SB4, master-first): services are concrete @Service classes — NO interface+Impl split. Best practice (verified via context7/Spring Boot docs): constructor injection + @ComponentScan recommended; return concrete types for max type info; Spring never mandates an interface for single-impl beans. Old code had 55 interfaces / 53 Impl, all 1:1, none with a 2nd impl — dead polymorphism. CQRS pairs ProfesiCommandService (JPA write) + ProfesiQueryService (JOOQ read) both concrete. See docs/adr/0007-concrete-services-no-interface.md. KISS/YAGNI: extract interface later if a real 2nd impl appears.

Rewrite read semantics (ADR-0014): GET /master/x/{id} on an absent row (never existed OR soft-deleted, hidden by @SQLRestriction is_deleted=FALSE) THROWS a typed not-found -> ADR-0013 advice renders ApiResponse status 404, data=null. Tidak membangun mesin tombstone-revival utk value-child. Bounds klausa soft-delete di ADR-0011 (DELETE per-anak tetap soft-delete; hanya CREATE yg plain-insert tanpa cek duplikat).

Rewrite Organisasi: GET /master/organisasi/{id}/parent is KEPT by name (client compat) but re-implemented. OLD impl was a copy-paste bug: findByParentId() ignored the parent and returned the node itself via findById(id), identical to findById endpoint (OrganisasiServiceImpl.java:46-50) — never actually served a tree. NEW contract: return the node's DIRECT CHILDREN as a plain UNPAGED list (List<OrganisasiListItem>-style), i.e. children whose parent_id = {id}. Rationale: index already supports ?parentId=X (paged) for children; /{id}/parent is the convenience unpaged variant. Note the name is misleading (says 'parent', returns children) but kept to avoid breaking existing frontend callers. JOOQ read side: SELECT ... WHERE parent_id = {id} AND is_deleted=false. Master trees (Organisasi, Jabatan) are otherwise FLAT in responses: embed parent as a mini record (Q35), never nest a children[] array. Jabatan has NO /{id}/parent endpoint (its /organisasi/{id} is a legit working filter), so this quirk is Organisasi-only. Not an ADR (reversible endpoint contract, low surprise once documented).

Master read DTOs: the self-referential parent reference (Organisasi.parent, Jabatan.parent) gets its OWN mini record preserving {id, kode, nama, shortName} — NOT collapsed to the uniform RefItem(id,nama). Reason: old API already returns parent.kode + parent.shortName; collapsing would silently drop two response fields (breaking change). Cheap via JOOQ self-join. RefItem(id,nama) stays only for true id+nama-only refs (Profesi APD/alat-kerja children). Decided in grilling Q35=A.

HariLibur adalah SATU-SATUNYA index master yang menyimpang dari locked index-filter contract (free-text->ilike, FK/enum/int->equal). Filter index-nya CALENDAR-SHAPED, faithful port dari kode lama (HariLiburRequest): tahun (default LocalDate.now().getYear()) + bulan (Integer, opsional) + jenisLibur (EJenisLibur, equal). Di JOOQ read query: year(HARI_LIBUR.TANGGAL).eq(tahun) dan month(HARI_LIBUR.TANGGAL).eq(bulan), bukan equal pada raw date. Alasan: kalender hari libur secara domain di-browse per tahun/bulan, bukan per tanggal persis; raw-date equal salah bentuk. Ini per-entity EXCEPTION terhadap kontrak filter index, didokumentasikan sebagai memory BUKAN ADR (faithful port perilaku yang sudah ada, trivially reversible, tidak mengejutkan untuk kalender). Deductive (no fork, silent): (1) revive-on-create ADR-0005 berlaku apa adanya, hanya native tombstone lookup-nya findAnyByTanggal(LocalDate) bukan tuple nama -> UNIQUE(tanggal); (2) jenisLibur enum->equal sudah tercakup kontrak. HariLibur tetap CRUD standar /master/hari-libur (first-class lookup, bukan dilipat). Entitas: tanggal LocalDate (UNIQUE) / jenisLibur EJenisLibur / notes String.

Rewrite master (ProfesiDetail read side): apdList + alatKerjaList loaded via JOOQ MULTISET. On MariaDB MULTISET is emulated as group_concat(json_array(...) SEPARATOR ',') -> JSON; NO native MULTISET. KNOWN GOTCHA: MariaDB group_concat_max_len default = 1024 bytes/group; if a profesi's children JSON exceeds it MariaDB SILENTLY TRUNCATES -> malformed JSON -> JOOQ parse error (not graceful empty list). DECISION (Q27=A): keep MULTISET, rely on default, do NOT raise group_concat_max_len. Justification: APD + Alat Kerja per profesi are always small bounded lists (handful of {id,nama}), KISS. Documented assumption in CONTEXT.md. Revisit only if a real profesi ever exceeds the limit (then switch to SET SESSION group_concat_max_len).

Rewrite build.gradle.kts (Spring Boot 4.0.3) keeps the io.spring.dependency-management plugin (version 1.1.4) rather than the Gradle-native platform(SpringBootPlugin.BOM_COORDINATES) import. plugins { id("org.springframework.boot") version "4.0.3"; id("io.spring.dependency-management") version "1.1.4" }.
